title: Insure workers for workers' compensation
what: Insure every worker under the state's workers' compensation scheme (or be a licensed self-insurer).

sources.title: Workers Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 1988 (Tas)
sources.publisher: Tasmanian Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An employer who is not a self-insurer shall maintain in force with a licensed insurer a policy of insurance – (a) that indemnifies him in respect of the full amount of his liabilities to pay compensation under this Act;

assessment.summary: Every employer must insure its workers under the state or territory's workers' compensation scheme.

marks.reason: Premiums, wage declarations and claims administration for every employer.
